item.address: 100 Prince Alfred Parade, Newport NSW 2106, NSW 2106
item.description:
Positioned in one of Newport's most tightly held deep waterfront enclaves, this remarkable residence captures the very essence of Pittwater living. Designed by acclaimed architect Rowan Stewart, the home unfolds across multiple levels, drawing in breathtaking water views at every turn while delivering a refined balance of scale, privacy and effortless indoor/outdoor connection.
Crafted for both relaxed family living and grand-scale entertaining, the property is defined by its exceptional waterfront amenities - from a private sandy beach and deepwater jetty to a glistening pool at the water's edge. With seamless access via inclinator and every modern comfort considered, it presents a fabulous opportunity to secure a landmark holding in one of the Northern Beaches' most desirable settings.
- Multi-level design maximising its premier waterfront position 
- Expansive glass and seamless connection to outdoor living 
- Designer kitchen with cellar and premium European appliances 
- Sweeping Pittwater views with a prized northfacing aspect 
- Luxurious parents' retreat with dual ensuites and balcony 
- Underfloor heating in master ensuites; main living and bathroom
- New bunk room to the self-contained studio; private entry, ideal for guests
- Electric shutters and blinds in bedrooms; ducted air conditioning 
- Waterside pool, level lawns and pool house set on the shoreline 
- Home cinema, surround sound, C-Bus integration and gas fireplace 
- Deepwater jetty, permanent mooring, inclinator, private sandy beach 
- Moments to local shops, schools, Royal Motor and RPA yacht clubs
